object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Attach an SVG file to an object through set_figure, then read the object and an object without a figure with show_object; in the library, attach a second SVG over the first. Expected: the figure file figures/<object ID>.svg holds the chosen file's bytes and is named in the call's affected files; show_object gives it as the object's figure and none for the other object; after the second attach the figure file holds the second file's bytes.
